name: NUSTAR Run 2026
short_description: NUSTAR Run 2026 is a 21.1 km half-marathon held on August 23, 2026 at NUSTAR Resort, Cebu City, Philippines.
ai_summary: NUSTAR Run 2026 is a half-marathon event scheduled for August 23, 2026, held in Cebu City, Philippines. The race is organized by NUSTAR Resort and starts at NUSTAR Resort, Cebu City. The event offers a 21.1 km distance for participants. Registration details have not yet been announced, so prospective runners should watch for updates.
pros: Hosted at the well-known NUSTAR Resort in Cebu City
Organized directly by NUSTAR Resort, ensuring a dedicated event host
Offers a standard half-marathon distance of 21.1 km
cons: Registration status has not yet been announced, so sign-up details are unavailable
research_highlights: This is the first-ever edition of NUSTAR Run, scheduled for August 23, 2026, so there is no prior-year participant feedback to draw on.
Race distances offered are 21KM, 16KM, 10KM, 6KM, 3KM, and 1KM, starting at NUSTAR, South Road Properties (SRP), Cebu City.
The race is led by Janice Pasculado, described as Cebu's first female race director, and benefits the Kapwa Ko Mahal Ko Foundation.
Registration is handled online via myruntime.com/events, with an early-bird pricing period.
The run is part of NUSTAR Resort's month-long 'In Full Balance' Wellness Month 2026 campaign, which also includes yoga and sound healing sessions at the resort.
